card.name: Inside all-caps section headings
card.fires_on: Words or word pieces inside all-caps label headings such as WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS, PATIENT COUNSELING INFORMATION, and DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE. It also fires on commas and pieces inside boxed-warning title lists.

modes.label: Heading split mid-word
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a capitalized heading word, like PAT-IENT or PRE-CA-UTIONS.

modes.label: Joiners in warning titles
modes.description: An 'AND' or comma between capitalized items in a heading or boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH OPIOIDS; ABUSE<<,>> MISUSE, AND ADDICTION;

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the capitalized section titles in drug labels, such as Warnings and Precautions.
